北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京体感 -7℃，风大天晴，注意防寒保暖哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing feels like -7℃ with strong wind and clear skies. Remember to stay warm!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪有雾气，体感 -2℃。开车慢行，注意安全。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is foggy, feels like -2℃. Drive slowly and stay safe.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海晴好，微风宜人，出门多晒晒太阳吧！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is sunny and breezy. Enjoy some sunshine outdoors!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州气温 4℃，有点冷哦，早晚多添衣物。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is 4℃, a bit chilly. Add more layers in the morning and evening.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳晴天，气温 10℃。早晚凉，别忘了外套。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is sunny, 10℃. It's cool morning and night, don't forget your jacket.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州晴朗，体感 0℃。出门别忘了保暖，多喝热水。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is sunny, feels like 0℃. Stay warm and drink more hot water.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京晴天体感 1℃，出门记得穿暖和点。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is sunny, feels like 1℃. Remember to dress warmly when going out.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都湿度 100%，体感 -1℃。湿冷注意防寒哦。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is 100% humid, feels like -1℃. Guard against the damp cold.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉有雾，体感 -2℃。早晚出行注意慢行。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is foggy, feels like -2℃. Drive slowly during morning and evening commutes.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天，体感 -1℃。天气干燥，多喝水。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy, feels like -1℃. It's dry, so drink plenty of water.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆有雾，体感 3℃。路面湿滑，请小心驾驶。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is foggy, feels like 3℃. Roads might be slippery, please drive carefully.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨体感 -28℃，超级冷！务必穿暖再出门。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin feels like -28℃, it's super cold! Make sure to bundle up before going out.
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -28℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳大风，体感 -21℃。风寒效应强，多穿衣。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang has strong winds, feels like -21℃. The wind chill is severe, dress warmly.
沈阳.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -21℃ | 💨 北风警报：北风 5级

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云，气温 7℃。早晚温差大，注意添衣。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy, 7℃. There's a big temperature difference, add layers.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门有雾，体感 5℃。路面湿滑，请小心慢行。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is foggy, feels like 5℃. Roads are slippery, please proceed slowly and carefully.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛风力 6级，体感 -6℃。风大体感冷，注意防风。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao has 6-level winds, feels like -6℃. It's very windy and cold, protect yourself from the wind.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连体感 -11℃，风力 4级。注意防风保暖哦。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian feels like -11℃ with 4-level winds. Remember to stay warm and protect against wind.
